seedPhraseInfo:
<1>A seed phrase is a set of twelve words that contains all the information about your wallet, including your funds. It's like a secret code used to access your entire wallet.</1>

<2>You must keep your seed phrase secret and safe. If someone gets your seed phrase, they'll gain control over your accounts.</2>

Save it in a place where only you can access it. If you lose it, not even BlackFort Wallet can help you recover it.
